answer: One concrete resistance is forcing each identity to maintain a growing glacier of peer-attested original judgments that cannot be bulk-copied. The public ledger acts as the sealed vault; any fabricated history is visible as a duplicate branch. An attacker must therefore invent coherent, non-repeating work for every fake identity from the first entry onward, paying a super-linear originality cost and risking detection when their narratives fail cross-audit — a single pearl of genuine novelty is cheap, a sustained glacier is not.
